title: Design System: Node-Based Web Audio Chain Builder

title.purpose: The working title's silkscreen legend on the status strip.

body.purpose: Prose values, button labels, toast summaries.

label.purpose: Panel headers, param labels, readout labels, optgroup legends — the surface-wide micro-label.

readout.purpose: Every machine value: sample rate, latency, meters, preset names, param values. Mono + tabular numerals.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: The faint module seat — cards are inserted, not floating.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Dragged clones and floating toasts — things held above the faceplate.

motion.name: state-answer
motion.purpose: Default state transition for colors/borders — every control answers within it.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entrance; no exit animation by construction. Guarded by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: agent-breath
motion.purpose: The agent-acting status lamp — the single slow-animation exception. Guarded; copy carries the state either way.

components.name: Primary Button (Start)
components.description: The one amber-filled action — Start. Ink-on-amber text, dark focus ring inside the fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-active); border-color: var(--accent-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-on-accent); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Control Button
components.description: The shared secondary control: card ground, bezel outline, amber-leaning hover, ink-on-amber press.
components.css: .ds-btn-control { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-control:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-control:active { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); } .ds-btn-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-control:active:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus-ring-on-accent); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Bypass Button
components.description: The safety-critical control — loudest on the strip. Red-edge halo at rest; red-fill with white text when engaged.
components.css: .ds-btn-bypass { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.65rem 1.6rem; border: 2px solid var(--red-edge); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-panel); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-bypass.engaged { background: var(--red-fill); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-bypass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Palette Chip
components.description: A draggable module source: family legend square + silkscreen label; hover raises the bezel and a family top edge.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: grab; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-chip::before { content: attr(data-initials); flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--family-reverb); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 var(--family-reverb); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Agent Chip
components.description: Strip-native reporter (never a control): quiet pill; live states lift the bezel, amber the label, and light an 8px amber square.
components.css: .ds-agent-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-card); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-agent-chip::before { content: ''; flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-agent-chip-label { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Node Module Card
components.description: A channel-strip module: 3px family top edge, legend square, silkscreen label; collapses to the header-only slim row.
components.css: .ds-node-card { position: relative; min-width: 190px; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-top: 3px solid var(--family-eq); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-card); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-node-card::before { content: attr(data-initials); position: absolute; top: 0.5625rem; left: 0.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--family-eq); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-node-head { min-height: 1.5rem; padding-left: 1.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Fader (Param Slider)
components.description: Native range re-skinned as a console fader: hairline slot, detent ticks, center-unity notch, amber cap with ink position line.
components.css: .ds-fader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.2rem 0.6rem; padding: 0.25rem 0; } .ds-fader-label { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-fader-value { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-fader-input { order: 3; flex: 1 1 100%; height: 1.25rem; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; background: transparent; } .ds-fader-input::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--line-strong) calc(50% - 1px), var(--line-strong) calc(50% + 1px), transparent calc(50% + 1px)), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--hairline) 0, var(--hairline) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 12px), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--hairline) calc(50% - 1px), var(--hairline) calc(50% + 1px), transparent calc(50% + 1px)); } .ds-fader-input::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 12px; height: 18px; margin-top: -5px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 3px; background-color: var(--accent); background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--on-accent) calc(50% - 1px), var(--on-accent) calc(50% + 1px), transparent calc(50% + 1px)); } .ds-fader-input::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover { background-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-fader-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Agent Toast
components.description: Change summary with one Undo action; mono machine footnotes under a hairline seam. Refusals carry a 2px red bezel.
components.html:
Added compressor, set threshold −24 dB
clamped: ceiling −6 dBFS
components.css: .ds-toast { max-width: 340px; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-card); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-toast-note { margin-top: 0.45rem; padding-top: 0.45rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-toast-undo { margin-top: 0.5rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast-undo:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-toast-undo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-on-accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-toast.refused { border: 2px solid var(--red-edge); }

narrative.overview:
This is pro-audio rack gear built for the road, not for a studio shelf. Every surface answers three questions before it earns a pixel: can the operator read it from two meters away in a dark venue, does every lamp and silkscreen legend mean something, and will it still work when the show is already running. The console is warm industrial — brushed warm-charcoal steel, toolroom honesty, and one amber signal register that glows only where the machine speaks.

The visitor here is an operator mid-task, never a browse. Physical metaphors carry the whole vocabulary: module cards are channel strips with family color on their top edge the way real gear codes rack modules; sliders are faders with detent ticks, center-unity notches, and amber caps carrying an ink position line; the top bar is a status LCD strip whose mono readouts are machine registers. Depth is tonal first — a chassis → faceplate → module-card ground stack — and real shadows appear only when something physically lifts off the rack (a dragged card, a floating toast).

The one confirmed anti-reference: this is not a neon terminal, not a webfonts showcase, not a decorative-motion piece. No display fonts in UI, no invented brand imagery, no glow. Confidence comes from restraint and redundant encoding — color is never the only signal anywhere in the system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal three-ground tonal stack (chassis → faceplate → module card); depth by layering, shadows only on lift.
One amber signal accent for action and machine attention; ink-on-amber fills, never amber-on-amber.
Two type registers: silkscreen legends for humans, mono LCD/VFD readouts for machine values.
Family color as edge marking (never fill) with always-present text labels — redundant encoding everywhere.
Split-role safety red: the Bypass control outranks everything on the strip.
150–250 ms state transitions only; meter ballistics and the agent breath are functional, not decorative; prefers-reduced-motion respected throughout.
Console-grade density: 11 px text floor, tracked uppercase micro-labels, tabular numerals in every readout.

rules.name: The Split-Role Red Rule
rules.body: Edge red is for rings and bezels; fill red is for solid fills with white text. Never swap them: white on edge red fails (3.91), fill red as an edge fails (2.65).

rules.name: The Amber Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber speaks for action and machine attention only — never as decoration, never as large-area fill. Its rarity on the dark chassis is what makes it readable at distance.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Hairlines are seams, not outlines. Anything meaningful (interactive bezels, floating-card boundaries, family identity) uses the Bezel Line token; anything merely decorative uses the hairline.

rules.name: The Register Rule
rules.body: If a value is machine state, it renders in the mono readout register with tabular numerals; if it is a human label, it renders as a silkscreen legend. Nothing in between.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders below 11px anywhere (0.6875rem initials and 0.7rem labels are the floor after the density pass) — distance legibility is a product requirement.

rules.name: The Rest-Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a shadow means physical lift (drag, float). No ambient glow, no hover shadows.

dos: Do extend the token set — introduce no raw hex values; new colors enter as :root tokens in the rq5-verified vocabulary.
Do keep color redundant: every family edge pairs with its legend square initials and a text label; every state change is copy + color.
Do use tabular numerals and fixed min-widths in readouts so machine values never pump layout.
Do draw focus rings with the global 2px token, switching to the dark inside-fill ring on amber surfaces.
Do keep state transitions at 150–250 ms and guard every motion addition with prefers-reduced-motion; meter ballistics stay live by drawing per-frame.
donts: Don't swap the safety red roles (edge ↔ fill) or put white text on edge red.
Don't render text below 11px, use webfonts/CDN assets, or add display fonts to the UI.
Don't use amber as decoration, large-area fill, or an amber-on-amber focus ring.
Don't add glow, load choreography, or hover shadows — shadows mean physical lift only.
Don't let anything on the status strip outrank BYPASS in loudness; don't move it from the visible top on narrow widths.
Don't invent brand imagery, logos, or a product name — the working title stands until the user chooses one.
